# Manual Workflow Templates

Use these templates to keep the manual-first task records together:

- [`plan.md`](plan.md) - Maintained by the main agent; defines the goal, worktree, constraints, scope, non-goals, and completion conditions.
- [`progress.md`](progress.md) - Maintained by the execution agent; records current state, completed work, decisions, blockers, risks, and next steps.
- [`review.md`](review.md) - Maintained by the main agent; records the diff review decision, findings, rework request, and remaining risk.
